1. import { Application, Context } from 'probot' // eslint-disable-line no-unused-vars
2. import {
3.   PullRequestsCreateReviewParams, IssuesAddLabelsParams, PullRequestsListReviewsParams, PullRequestsListReviewsResponse
4. } from '@octokit/rest'
5. 
6. const getConfig = require('probot-config')
7. 
8. export = (app: Application) => {
9.   app.on(['pull_request.opened', 'pull_request.reopened', 'pull_request.labeled', 'pull_request.edited', 'pull_request_review'], async (context) => {
10.     // reading configuration
11.     const config = await getConfig(context, 'autoapproval.yml')
12.     context.log(config, '\n\nLoaded config')
13.     context.log('Repo: %s', context.payload.repository.full_name)
14. 
15.     const pr = context.payload.pull_request
16.     context.log('PR: %s', pr.html_url)
17.     const prLabels: string[] = pr.labels.map((label: any) => label.name)
18. 
19.     // determine if the PR has any "blacklisted" labels
20.     var blacklistedLabels: string[] = []
21.     if (config.blacklisted_labels) {
22.       blacklistedLabels = config.blacklisted_labels
23.         .filter((blacklistedLabel: any) => prLabels.includes(blacklistedLabel))
24. 
25.       // if PR contains any black listed labels, do not proceed further
26.       if (blacklistedLabels.length > 0) {
27.         context.log('PR black listed from approving: %s', blacklistedLabels)
28.         return
29.       }
30.     }
31. 
32.     // reading pull request owner info and check it with configuration
33.     const ownerSatisfied = config.from_owner.length === 0 || config.from_owner.includes(pr.user.login)
34. 
35.     // reading pull request labels and check them with configuration
36.     let requiredLabelsSatisfied
37.     if (config.required_labels_mode == "one_of") {
38.       // one of the required_labels needs to be applied
39.       const appliedRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
40.         .filter((requiredLabel: any) => prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
41.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = appliedRequiredLabels.length > 0
42. 
43.     } else {
44.       // all of the required_labels need to be applied
45.       const missingRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
46.         .filter((requiredLabel: any) => !prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
47.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = missingRequiredLabels.length === 0
48.     }
49. 
50.     if (requiredLabelsSatisfied && ownerSatisfied) {
51.       const reviews = await getAutoapprovalReviews(context)
52. 
53.       if (reviews.length > 0) {
54.         context.log('PR has already reviews')
55.         if (context.payload.action === 'dismissed') {
56.           approvePullRequest(context)
57.           applyLabels(context, config.apply_labels as string[])
58.           context.log('Review was dismissed, approve again')
59.         }
60.       } else {
61.         approvePullRequest(context)
62.         applyLabels(context, config.apply_labels as string[])
63.         context.log('PR approved first time')
64.       }
65.     } else {
66.       // one of the checks failed
67.       context.log('Condition failed! \n - missing required labels: %s\n - PR owner found: %s', requiredLabelsSatisfied, ownerSatisfied)
68.     }
69.   })
70. }
71. 
72. async function approvePullRequest (context: Context) {
73.   const prParams = context.issue({ event: 'APPROVE', body: 'Approved :+1:' })
74.   await context.github.pullRequests.createReview(prParams as PullRequestsCreateReviewParams)
75. }
76. 
77. async function applyLabels (context: Context, labels: string[]) {
78.   // if there are labels required to be added, add them
79.   if (labels.length > 0) {
80.     // trying to apply existing labels to PR. If labels didn't exist, this call will fail
81.     const labelsParam = context.issue({ labels: labels })
82.     await context.github.issues.addLabels(labelsParam as IssuesAddLabelsParams)
83.   }
84. }
85. 
86. async function getAutoapprovalReviews (context: Context): Promise<PullRequestsListReviewsResponse> {
87.   const reviewParams = context.issue()
88.   const reviews = await context.github.pullRequests.listReviews(reviewParams as PullRequestsListReviewsParams)
89. 
90.   const autoapprovalReviews = (reviews.data as PullRequestsListReviewsResponse)
91.     .filter(item => item.user.login === 'autoapproval[bot]')
92. 
93.   return autoapprovalReviews
94. }
95.

   "version": "1.0.0",
   "description": "The bot for approving pull requests automatically",
   "author": "Dmytro Khmelenko <d.khmelenko@gmail.com> (dkhmelenko.github.io)",
   "license": "ISC",
   "repository": "https://github.com//autoapproval.git",
   "homepage": "https://github.com//autoapproval",
   "bugs": "https://github.com//autoapproval/issues",
   "keywords": [
     "probot",
     "github",
     "probot-app"
   ],
   "scripts": {
     "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json",
     "dev": "nodemon --exec \"npm start\"",
     "start": "probot run ./lib/index.js",
     "lint": "standard **/*.ts --fix",
     "test": "jest --coverage && standard **/*.ts",
     "test:watch": "jest --watch --notify --notifyMode=change --coverage",
     "heroku-postbuild": "echo Skip build on Heroku"
   },
   "dependencies": {
     "@types/nock": "^11.1.0",
     "btoa": "^1.2.1",
     "nock": "^13.0.11",
     "probot": "^7.5.3",
     "probot-config": "^1.1.0"
   },
   "devDependencies": {
     "@types/jest": "^26.0.22",
     "@types/node": "^15.6.1",
     "eslint-plugin-typescript": "^0.14.0",
     "jest": "^25.5.4",
     "nodemon": "^2.0.7",
     "smee-client": "^1.2.2",
     "standard": "^16.0.3",
     "ts-jest": "^25.5.1",
     "typescript": "^3.9.9",
     "typescript-eslint-parser": "^22.0.0"
   },
   "engines": {
     "node": ">= 8.3.0"
   },
   "standard": {
     "parser": "typescript-eslint-parser",
     "env": [
       "jest"
     ],
     "plugins": [
       "typescript"
     ],
     "ignore": [
       "/lib/*"
     ]
   },
   "jest": {
     "testEnvironment": "node"
   },
   "heroku-run-build-script": true
 }

1. import { Application, Context } from 'probot' // eslint-disable-line no-unused-vars
2. import {
3.   PullRequestsCreateReviewParams, IssuesAddLabelsParams, PullRequestsListReviewsParams, PullRequestsListReviewsResponse
4. } from '@octokit/rest'
5. 
6. const getConfig = require('probot-config')
7. 
8. interface AutoapprovalConfig {
9.   from_owner: string[]
10.   required_labels: string[]
11.   required_labels_mode?: string
12.   blacklisted_labels: string[]
13.   apply_labels: string[]
14. }
15. 
16. export = (app: Application) => {
17.   app.on(['pull_request.opened', 'pull_request.reopened', 'pull_request.labeled', 'pull_request.edited', 'pull_request_review'], async (context) => {
18.     // reading configuration
19.     const config = normalizeConfig(await getConfig(context, 'autoapproval.yml'))
20.     context.log(config, '\n\nLoaded config')
21.     context.log('Repo: %s', context.payload.repository.full_name)
22. 
23.     const pr = context.payload.pull_request
24.     context.log('PR: %s', pr.html_url)
25.     const prLabels: string[] = pr.labels.map((label: any) => label.name)
26. 
27.     // determine if the PR has any "blacklisted" labels
28.     const blacklistedLabels = config.blacklisted_labels
29.       .filter((blacklistedLabel: string) => prLabels.includes(blacklistedLabel))
30. 
31.     // if PR contains any black listed labels, do not proceed further
32.     if (blacklistedLabels.length > 0) {
33.       context.log('PR black listed from approving: %s', blacklistedLabels)
34.       return
35.     }
36. 
37.     // reading pull request owner info and check it with configuration
38.     const ownerSatisfied = config.from_owner.length === 0 || config.from_owner.includes(pr.user.login)
39. 
40.     // reading pull request labels and check them with configuration
41.     let requiredLabelsSatisfied
42.     if (config.required_labels_mode === 'one_of') {
43.       // one of the required_labels needs to be applied
44.       const appliedRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
45.         .filter((requiredLabel: string) => prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
46.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = appliedRequiredLabels.length > 0
47. 
48.     } else {
49.       // all of the required_labels need to be applied
50.       const missingRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
51.         .filter((requiredLabel: string) => !prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
52.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = missingRequiredLabels.length === 0
53.     }
54. 
55.     if (requiredLabelsSatisfied && ownerSatisfied) {
56.       const reviews = await getAutoapprovalReviews(context)
57. 
58.       if (reviews.length > 0) {
59.         context.log('PR has already reviews')
60.         if (context.payload.action === 'dismissed') {
61.           await approvePullRequestAndApplyLabels(context, config.apply_labels)
62.           context.log('Review was dismissed, approve again')
63.         }
64.       } else {
65.         await approvePullRequestAndApplyLabels(context, config.apply_labels)
66.         context.log('PR approved first time')
67.       }
68.     } else {
69.       // one of the checks failed
70.       context.log('Condition failed! \n - missing required labels: %s\n - PR owner found: %s', requiredLabelsSatisfied, ownerSatisfied)
71.     }
72.   })
73. }
74. 
75. function normalizeConfig (config: Partial<AutoapprovalConfig> | null): AutoapprovalConfig {
76.   return {
77.     from_owner: config && config.from_owner ? config.from_owner : [],
78.     required_labels: config && config.required_labels ? config.required_labels : [],
79.     required_labels_mode: config ? config.required_labels_mode : undefined,
80.     blacklisted_labels: config && config.blacklisted_labels ? config.blacklisted_labels : [],
81.     apply_labels: config && config.apply_labels ? config.apply_labels : []
82.   }
83. }

85. async function approvePullRequest (context: Context) {
86.   const prParams = context.issue({ event: 'APPROVE', body: 'Approved :+1:' })
87.   await context.github.pullRequests.createReview(prParams as PullRequestsCreateReviewParams)
88. }

90. async function approvePullRequestAndApplyLabels (context: Context, labels: string[]) {
91.   await Promise.all([
92.     approvePullRequest(context),
93.     applyLabels(context, labels)
94.   ])

97. async function applyLabels (context: Context, labels: string[]) {
98.   // if there are labels required to be added, add them
99.   if (labels.length > 0) {
100.     // trying to apply existing labels to PR. If labels didn't exist, this call will fail
101.     const labelsParam = context.issue({ labels: labels })
102.     await context.github.issues.addLabels(labelsParam as IssuesAddLabelsParams)
103.   }
104. }

106. async function getAutoapprovalReviews (context: Context): Promise<PullRequestsListReviewsResponse> {
107.   const reviewParams = context.issue()
108.   const reviews = await context.github.pullRequests.listReviews(reviewParams as PullRequestsListReviewsParams)
109. 
110.   const autoapprovalReviews = (reviews.data as PullRequestsListReviewsResponse)
111.     .filter(item => item.user && item.user.login === 'autoapproval[bot]')
112. 
113.   return autoapprovalReviews

data.content:
Implemented the source-side compatibility fix for the `mime-db` upgrade.

Changed `src/index.ts` and rebuilt `lib/` so webhook handling now:
- normalizes missing config fields to safe defaults
- awaits approval/label API calls instead of fire-and-forget
- handles reviews with a missing `user`
- keeps existing approval/label behavior intact

`npm run build` and the Jest suite pass. The full `npm test` script still exits during `standard` because the existing lint setup cannot load `typescript-eslint-parser`’s `eslint/lib/util/traverser`, which also occurred before these changes.
